preliminary_jev_runs_excluded.jev-initial.json: 1 client probability-validation failure in 300 requests; probability details were not retained for that response.
preliminary_jev_runs_excluded.jev.json: 2 client probability-validation failures in 300 requests. Both responses chose the reference category; their two-decimal probability totals were 0.99. Final run preserves these rounding deviations as warnings.

notes: 100 independent synthetic emails per pass, 12 categories; work and other have no positive cases. Authored labels are not independently adjudicated accuracy.
Three passes: concurrency 1, then 4, then 4; four-call headline is the arithmetic mean of the two measured pass durations. No automatic retries.
Caches remain enabled and are not reset. Smoke tests ran before measured passes. Results measure observed serving state, not cold-start latency.
Same semantic guide, email fields, and category definitions. Clef receives reusable context/cache extensions; JEV receives guide in state; all services return a choice with probabilities.
Persistent HTTP/1.1 connections. End-to-end cloud timing includes internet and provider scheduling, local timing includes LAN and FIFO queue. Cloud GPU/kernel inference time is unavailable.
Local tests run sequentially on one GPU per service. No GPU power or service configuration was changed. 400 W is the 3090 power limit, not constant consumption.
One serial and two concurrent passes do not establish statistical confidence intervals or long-term service guarantees.
